title: Afshan Pattern floral carpet (red ground), 18th century, Khanate Period, Kuba or Baku Region, Azerba
notes: Afshan Pattern floral carpet (red ground), 18th century, Khanate Period, Kuba or Baku Region, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. inv. no 880 (1-721) from the Mosque of Ali Pasha at Tokat. 260 x 570 cm. Rosettes and stars on five longitudinal axes, while between these motifs fine green curves stems linked by segmented leaves and palmettes follow these axes. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 63
